svg.title: An island around Zarathustra
svg.desc: One circular island. The gallery at its centre. Ocean all around. Built footprints and streets share the physical city coordinates. The civic core has sixfold symmetry; established districts remain adapted to their real entrances.

rect.title: Saved homes · reserved neighbourhood, designs remain private
